dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 你閒暇時間鍾意做啲咩？
dialogue.en: What do you like to do in your free time?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我好鍾意睇書，星期日成日打網球。
dialogue.en: I love reading, and I often play tennis on Sundays.

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 真㗎？好好嘅嗜好呀。我鍾意多啲游水。
dialogue.en: Really? That is a great hobby. I prefer swimming.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 你喺泳池游定喺海度游？
dialogue.en: Do you swim in a pool or in the sea?

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: 多數喺泳池，因為離我屋企好近。
dialogue.en: Mostly in a pool, because it is close to my house.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我哋有日可以一齊做運動。
dialogue.en: We could do some sport together one day.
